claimBoundary: This freezes the no-mandatory-model-download comparison before the result exists. It is not evidence that Algi matches or beats model-only Scion until same-commit artifacts pass the executable audit.

arms.algiResearch: Cold Algi research-first route: no model weights, empty project research cache, consented live providers, evidence graph, deterministic compiler.
arms.algiCached: Warm Algi route using only the exact verified project evidence saved by algiResearch, with provider network disabled.
arms.scionModelOnly: Cold Scion browser-local base route with Algi source research disabled and the same compiler configuration.

courses.prompt: User Experience Evidence Studio, exactly five lessons: 1) research questions and study planning, 2) contextual inquiry and field notes, 3) affinity mapping and synthesis, 4) usability test design, and 5) evidence-based design recommendations. Students produce a traceable research report.

Environmental Microbiology, exactly five lessons: 1) microbial ecology, 2) waterborne pathogens, 3) biofilms, 4) bioremediation, and 5) microbial risk assessment. Students use field evidence and state uncertainty.

Introduction to Quantum Computing, exactly five lessons: 1) qubits and quantum states, 2) superposition and measurement, 3) quantum gates and circuits, 4) entanglement, and 5) quantum error correction. Students compare classical and quantum representations without unsupported hardware claims.

Business Ethics and Responsible Decision-Making, exactly five lessons: 1) stakeholder analysis, 2) duties to workers, 3) conflicts of interest, 4) whistleblowing and retaliation, and 5) accountable case recommendations. Students justify decisions from explicit evidence.

World Literature and Comparative Reading, exactly five lessons: 1) world literature and circulation, 2) oral epic, 3) frame narratives, 4) translation and cultural mediation, and 5) comparative close reading. Students ground interpretations in assigned passages and name counter-readings.

Current Technology Policy, exactly five lessons: 1) platform governance, 2) current artificial-intelligence regulation, 3) privacy and data protection, 4) algorithmic accountability standards, and 5) evidence-based policy recommendations. Every current claim must name its date and source.

Public Health Program Planning, exactly five lessons: 1) community needs assessment, 2) social determinants of health, 3) intervention design, 4) implementation barriers, and 5) evaluation metrics. Students distinguish current guidance from durable background knowledge.

Global Art History and Visual Evidence, exactly five lessons: 1) object-based visual analysis, 2) colonial circulation and provenance, 3) photography and modernity, 4) protest art, and 5) comparative curatorial interpretation. Students distinguish sourced historical claims from interpretation.
